12. Fixation of pay on appointment to an ex cadre post.A Central Government servant appointed on deputation to an ex cadre post may elect to draw either the pay in the scale of pay of the ex cadre post or his Basic Pay in the parent cadre from time to time plus Deputation (Duty) Allowance at the prescribed rate thereon plus personal pay, if any.
